title: ProBuild Paint Benefit Card
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards members at the tiers below receive a discount on paint and paint sundries at the register, up to a yearly total of discount per program year. The card sets the rate, the yearly total and whether the discount applies to paint priced under a volume pricing quote.

| Tier | Discount on paint and paint sundries at the register | Largest total paint discount per program year | Applies to paint priced under a volume pricing quote |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 0 percent | USD 0.00 | No |
| ProBuild Bronze | 5 percent | USD 500.00 | No |
| ProBuild Silver | 10 percent | USD 1000.00 | No |
| ProBuild Gold | 15 percent | USD 2000.00 | No |
| ProBuild Platinum | 20 percent | USD 4000.00 | No |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 25 percent | USD 8000.00 | No |

## Points of reading

- At ProBuild Member the rate is 0 percent and the yearly total USD 0.00: no paint discount is given at that tier.
- At no tier does the paint discount apply to paint priced under a volume pricing quote.
- Hypothetical: USD 200.00 of paint sundries at ProBuild Gold carries a discount of 15 percent of USD 200.00, that is USD 30.00, while the yearly total of USD 2000.00 has not been reached.
